title: The eye has a hidden cleanup system scientists never knew existed
caption:
For over 100 years, experts believed the back of the eye was an isolated system. A new study in mice has identified a hidden drainage route that connects the retina to the body's lymphatic network, potentially opening new doors for treating conditions like glaucoma.

Source: Sciencedaily - The eye has a hidden cleanup system scientists never knew existed
